field_mapping.decision_and_limits: Native source IDs/revisions, one canonical URL, optional hash and upstream release/key are available. No typed accession/form, original+resolved URL pair, response metadata, hash-unavailable reason or exact representation/host roles. Keep source-native receipt externally. Never label analyst serialization hash as source bytes.

An issuer is an organization actor with verified external identity. Portfolio boundary remains scope prose. A publisher actor is not a physical asset; owner/operator/tenant/developer role and dated asset allocation are absent.

Preserve BOTH literal string components and namespace in the source-native layer. Upstream record_id can hold an unambiguous reversible composite serialization but schema cannot parse/check it. Do not put generator IDs into organization external_ids or pretend the operator actor is the generator. Native urn slug is lowercase; original uppercase CPP_1 belongs in upstream text, not lossy lowercasing.

No facility, campus, plant, generator, request or phase record type. Native subject targets are actor/model_version only. Keep asset graph external and require a reviewed extension before lossless native admission.

Distinct stable metric keys and definitions retain active/contracted/undelivered/eventual/net-summer/nameplate boundaries as text. No controlled basis enum or semantic comparability rule. One resource record holds one measurement; two rating assertions of one source row require separate resource measurements plus explicit common source key. This is not two physical units.

Native exact decimal strings reject JSON floats/exponents. Native unit registry has watt but no MW/GW, count but no GPUs, kWh/joule but no MWh/GWh. Any future SI-prefix conversion must be authorized, exact-decimal and versioned while retaining source lexeme/unit/precision. The tests convert only invented numbers. No energy→power, power→compute or generation→load conversion is justified.
Strict > maps to lower_bound with inclusive false; >= maps inclusive true. Bounds are not points and cannot support exact residuals.

source_native_fields: as displayed to one decimal; preliminary
field_mapping.decision_and_limits: No typed approximate/rounded/preliminary qualifier. Category can preserve wording or notes can preserve source lexical uncertainty, but neither automatically preserves usable numeric approximation semantics. Do not invent interval endpoints or silently admit a point. Rights govern excerpts.
No stock/flow/forecast-stock discriminator, common-vintage guard or no-double-counting invariant. Preserve external typed field and semantic acceptance requirements.

No commercial/construction/connection/operation axes, per-axis evidence/date or status-transition graph. Raw TS is a possible categorical lexical result but metric.unit remains required; do not invent a status unit or treat power metric plus category as approved mapping. A statement may retain attributed prose, but this is not a physical stage ontology.

event/published/evaluated allow instant/date/range/unknown; all five time fields required. Month can be inclusive month range at month precision. known_at/retrieved_at demand exact UTC timestamps: a historical date-only inspected_on cannot honestly invent midnight. New mapping time is not original source-retrieval time.

field_mapping.topic: forecast, acceptance, revision and source-created times
field_mapping.decision_and_limits: No resource forecast target/vintage, source acceptance, source-created or explicit revision-time fields. Quarter is not native temporal precision. Do not substitute times.event with forecast target or times.known_at with filing/acceptance. Keep raw timezone-unknown acceptance timestamp external.

Use reported for issuer/utility/agency assertions; official hosting or financial audit does not make measured. Measured requires identifiable evaluation procedure, estimated requires assumptions. No dedicated independence/source-dependency field. Review state is not physical validation.

field_mapping.topic: identity containment split and repeated disclosure
field_mapping.decision_and_limits: Multiple locators and exact revisions exist, but no general resource relationship graph or factual/possible/rejected edge enum. supersedes is correction history for SAME persistent record, not containment, asset split, general status transition or inferred identity. Evidence supports/contradicts/context is not asset-relationship typing.

Source availability enum is available/removed/restricted/unknown; missing result has six reasons. No request/error/complete-read taxonomy. Retrieval failure does not establish absence, commissioning, retirement or zero.

Record-level rights fields preserve basis/link. Detailed artifact exceptions, licensor, attribution and raw/quote/metadata scopes remain source-native detail. Native JSON Schema alone does not enforce publication prerequisites; documented companion validator is uninspected/unexecuted.
No typed AI attribution or allocation. Preserve unknown explicitly; no capacity/share computation.

Persistent IDs and required supersedes on revision >=2 are structural. Correct same-ID chain, duplicate semantics, prior stock retention and source-alias collapse need semantic logic; no adapter tested.

schema.description: Exact base-10 value; no exponent, commas, NaN, Infinity or binary floating-point JSON number. Original lexical precision is retained.
Persistent, type-prefixed identifier. Never reused for a different entity or observation.

revision.description: Exact immutable revision, never implicit latest.

schema.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp ending Z, at most six fractional digits; real calendar date is checked by FormatChecker.
Versioned unit identifier. Currency basis, score scale, hardware type and denominators belong in metric context.

at.description: Actual timestamp; do not invent midnight for date-only evidence.

date.description: Actual calendar day when day precision is all that is known.

precision.description: Precision supported by the source; endpoints are inclusive dates.

reason.description: Why no reliable time is available.

schema.description: Source-supported time with explicit precision; range endpoints must be ordered.

level.description: Coverage probability, only for confidence or credible intervals.

bound.description: Lower limit, not a point estimate.
Upper limit, not a point estimate.

value.description: Value at q, in stated unit.

quantiles.description: Strictly increasing q; nondecreasing values. No implied distribution between quantiles.

schema.description: Tagged value union; no midpoint substitutions or conversion of prose to invented probabilities.

key.description: Stable metric name, including a version when definitions change.

definition.description: What is counted or measured, including numerator and denominator.

direction.description: Direction under this metric, not a general safety judgment.

context.description: Hardware, currency base year, sample basis or other interpretation-critical context.

known_at.description: First recorded availability of this revision to this dataset; never backdate after late discovery.

retrieved_at.description: Time the underlying material was retrieved or captured for this revision.

published.description: When the underlying source was published.

event.description: When the described event happened, not its publication.

evaluated.description: When an evaluation was run; unknown with reason when not applicable.

source_ref.description: Source artifact and exact revision used.

locator.description: Page, section, table cell, transcript timestamp or other stable source selector.

excerpt.description: Optional short evidence text; distribute only if permitted.

extraction_method.description: How this evidence link was produced.

review_state.description: Evidence/attribution review; not a guarantee of truth.

reviewer_ref.description: Human or accountable organization recorded as reviewer.

rights_state.description: Export rights for content of this record; not inherited automatically from software or dataset license.

rights_basis.description: License, permission or reason for restriction; unknown is explicit.

publication_state.description: Eligible requires verified review and cleared rights; does not mean actually published.

observation_mode.description: Reported: another party claims it. Measured: identifiable evaluator ran it. Estimated: derived using assumptions.

method.description: Method and source of estimate; disclose assumptions and transformations.

uncertainty_notes.description: Sampling, contamination, measurement error and other uncertainty not encoded in value.

title.description: Source title in its source language.

source_type.description: Artifact type, separate from publisher nationality.

author_refs.description: May be empty when unknown; never invent a person author.

review_status.description: Language review, separate from evidence review.

notes.description: Preserved ambiguity, changes in terminology or omitted material.

actor_kind.description: Entity type; a collective represents surveyed or market participants, not the publisher.

population_scope.description: Inclusion frame and wave-specific population; do not imply representativeness.

code.description: ISO3166-1 alpha-2, EU, global or unknown.

relationship.description: Geographic relationship, never inferred from language.

jurisdictions.description: Multiple jurisdictions allowed; an empty array means not established.

namespace.description: ORCID, ROR or other named identifier registry.

value.description: Identifier as assigned by that registry.

items.description: Organization, model or infrastructure owner being measured.

scope.description: Per run, per token, annual, installed capacity or other denominator and boundary.

currency.description: ISO4217 original currency code. Conversion is optional and explicit.

conversion_method.description: Original currency, date and exchange/inflation source.

synthetic.description: True for test-only records, never mixed silently with real observations.

evidence.description: Traceable source references; empty only for source artifacts and snapshots.

supersedes.description: Immediately preceding revision of the same persistent record, for correction history.

key.description: Exact existing slug or identifier; no lossy implicit mapping.

legacy_refs.description: Optional additive bridge to the existing ledger.

dataset_id.description: Upstream dataset or provider identifier; preserve its own namespace.

release.description: Exact upstream release/version or dated snapshot identifier.

record_id.description: Original upstream row, question, run or cell identifier; never replace it silently.

schema_version.description: Original upstream schema version, or explicit unknown when not supplied.

source_ref.description: Evidence artifact for this upstream release or record.

description.description: Input fields, assumptions and any information loss.

transformations.description: Ordered transformations; empty means identity mapping without conversion.

upstream_refs.description: Crosswalk to upstream records. The upstream release stays authoritative; this envelope need not duplicate its whole dataset.

field_dictionary_audit.requiredness_note: Parent-local required lists and conditional requirements are preserved in native_definitions; field_dictionary requiredness is not globally transitive.

unit_registry.status: proposed starter vocabulary, not a complete ontology

units.definition: Fraction in [0,1]; never an unlabelled percentage.
Signed percentage change, not bounded above by 100.
Dimensionless ratio; valid scale is metric-specific.
Count or explicitly described mean/expectation; literal discreteness needs a metric-specific check.
Benchmark-specific scale, defined in metric; no universal normalization.
Integer Gregorian year 1..9999; preserves year-only forecast precision.
Seconds; clarify wall-clock, CPU or task duration in metric.
Hours; clarify time basis and denominator.
Tokens under a named tokenizer; aggregate means may be fractional.
Model parameters under a declared counting rule; active versus total must be distinguished.
Floating-point operations; specify counting convention, precision and scope.
Floating-point operations per second; distinguish theoretical peak from measured sustained throughput.
Accelerator-hours; hardware model, count and utilization basis must be explicit.
Power; installed capacity, rated draw and measured draw are distinct.
Energy with a declared system boundary.
Kilowatt-hours with a declared system boundary.
Signed amount in currency_basis.currency at stated date; nonnegative prices require metric minimum.
Signed constant-price amount with currency code, base year and adjustment method.
